simple.meaning: שֹׂרֵק (sôrêq) is a Hebrew word meaning “a vine stock (properly, one yielding purple grapes, the richest variety).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שֹׂרֵק (H8321) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 49:11, with occurrences in Genesis, Isaiah, Jeremiah.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שֹׂרֵק (H8321) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שֹׂרֵק (sôrêq) / H8321 is traced through Genesis 49:11, Isaiah 5:2, Jeremiah 2:21 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a vine stock (properly, one yielding purple grapes, the richest variety)
definitions.full: H8321. soreq I. שֹׂרֵק noun [masculine] choice species of vine ; — absolute ׳שׂ Isa 5:2 , ׳שׂוֺ Jer 2:21 (both in figure). שׂרֵקָה noun feminine choice vine ; — Gen 49:11 .
definitions.rootNote: or שׂוֹרֵק ; and (feminine) שֹׂרֵקָה ; from 8319 in the sense of redness (compare 8320 );
